verdict: 3M's sales inched up 1% to $6.6B, but profit jumped 65% to $1.4B — mainly because last year's quarter carried litigation and divestiture hits that did not repeat.

segments.name: Safety and Industrial
segments.note: Respirators, abrasives, tapes and adhesives for factories and workers — the growth engine this quarter, with Personal Safety up 8% and Fire Safety and Rescue nearly doubling.

segments.name: Transportation and Electronics
segments.note: Films, adhesives and materials for cars, aircraft and electronics — flat, as Electronics slipped 8%.

segments.name: Consumer
segments.note: Scotch tape, Post-it notes, Command strips and Filtrete filters — flat year over year.

segments.name: Corporate
segments.note: Sales not assigned to the three segments.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling 3M's tens of thousands of products and running the company.

opex.name: Research, development and related
opex.note: 3M's labs — the invention engine behind its product catalog.

otherDetail: Other income, net, of $112M — pension and other non-operating items — a swing from $300M of other expense in the year-ago quarter.
oneTimers: The year-ago quarter included a $161M loss on business divestitures and heavy litigation-related costs inside 'other expense' ($300M). This quarter those lines were quiet — other items were a net $112M of income — which explains most of the 65% profit jump.

takeaways.title: Safety carried the growth
takeaways.text: Safety and Industrial sales rose 9% to $3.2B, led by Personal Safety (+8%) and Fire Safety and Rescue, which nearly doubled to $206M. The other two segments were flat.

takeaways.title: GAAP beat adjusted — unusually
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS of $2.63 came in above adjusted EPS of $2.50: this quarter's special items (including the other-income swing) added to profit instead of subtracting from it.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: 3M lifted full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $9.10–$9.15 — management's signal that the underlying business, not just the one-offs, is improving.

footerNote: 3M does not print a gross-profit line; gross profit here is net sales less cost of sales, exactly as its statement foots. The small equity line nets $1M of income from unconsolidated subsidiaries against $37M of profit attributable to noncontrolling interests, giving the $1,373M attributable to 3M shareholders.
